hints.title: Triplet Parity Scan
hints.text: Examine every three adjacent elements arr[i], arr[i + 1], arr[i + 2].

hints.title: Odd Number Verification
hints.text: A number x is odd when x modulo 2 equals 1.

hints.title: Early Exit
hints.text: If all three elements in the current triplet are odd, return true immediately. If loop finishes, return false.
